stories.title: Forget 'trusting the process' -- it's a new era in...
stories.summary: Insiders question the move, but a source close to LeBron James put it simply: "I think he just realized he had a lot of meaningful basketball left in him."

stories.title: Jeudy disputes video appearing to show QB pick
stories.summary: Browns wide receiver Jerry Jeudy is pushing back against a viral video in which he appears to show his preference on who he believes should be named the team's starting quarterback.

stories.title: UNC places top Belichick aide Lombardi on leave
stories.summary: North Carolina football GM Michael Lombardi, a top aide to coach Bill Belichick, has been placed on paid administrative leave by the university.

stories.title: Sources: Nuggets matching Jones' offer sheet
stories.summary: The Nuggets have matched the Thunder's fully guaranteed two-year, $12 million offer sheet to Spencer Jones.

stories.title: Stanford players join group aiming to unionize
stories.summary: Stanford football players announced Monday the formation of a chapter of the College Football Players Association, which is pushing to eventually unionize college athletes.
